# XOR decryption:
# key starts at 0x62
# for each position i: input[i] ^ key == cipher[i]
# so: input[i] = cipher[i] ^ key
# then key += input[i]

key = 0x62
result = []

    char = cipher[i] ^ key
    result.append(char)
    key = (key + char) & 0xff  # keep it as a byte
